definitions.entries: Persisted actual-engine entries, including any open boundary positions. Period counts differ from closed-trade-only economic tables if exposure remains open.
definitions.episodes: BUY episodeId or SELL frozen breakout time/level, grouped by instrument and direction from broker-backed entry telemetry. Counts describe concentration, not proven independent samples.
definitions.gaps: Observed span between entries with start/end cohort boundaries included. Boundary-touching spans are censored; their length does not bound the eventual complete waiting time.
definitions.marketCoverage: Counts retained M15 start boundaries strictly inside the gap and their observed UTC dates. Each retained interval contributes 0.25 coverage hours. Missing intervals are not filled. These are observations, not all eligible setups, independent trials, market-session days or exact open-market duration.
